# OM-5 Mark II code loaded from the card, OMKit loader

After one flash, the loader runs OMKIT\CORE.BIN from the card on every full power-on, so core and modules update by copying files.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · **Project:** [OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)

**Firmware:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Mod build:** loader fw1100 (OMKit 0.1.0)

With the OMKit loader patch on firmware 1.1, the camera reads, checks and starts OMKIT\CORE.BIN from the card at each full power-on, and runs as stock with no card, no file, a bad file or OK held.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [OM-5 Mark II OMKit loader patch: developers' camera](../evidence/om5-ii-omkit-loader.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; reported hash.

## Limits

- Reported on one developers' camera; Wi-Fi and USB start paths are not verified.
- There is no isolation between modules and the firmware; a crashing module resets the camera and is not disabled automatically.
- Any official firmware update removes the loader; a new firmware needs a new loader and driver.
